output:
Done. Changed paths:

- `app.tsx` — `siblingKeys("projects")` now derives row keys from `visibleRoots` (first root per `projectId`), the same source the panel renders rows from. Previously a `Map` kept the **last** root per project, so for a project with copies on several hosts the sibling key (`B|h2`) never matched the rendered row key (`B|h1`): `reorder` bailed on `indexOf < 0`, drops did nothing, and `at = -1` disabled both move menu items. One-line fix at app.tsx:3463-3466.
- `project-reorder.test.tsx` — new jsdom test (panel.test.tsx harness) with 4 cases: single-host drop control, drop below a two-host project → `['B','A']`, dragging a two-host project below another → `['A','B']`, and the "Move up" row-menu item on a two-host project → enabled and calls `['B','A']`.

Verification (all run in this session, exit 0):
- `sh /tmp/pf-reorder/check.sh` — 3 passed
- `npx vitest run project-reorder.test.tsx` — 4 passed
- `npx vitest run panel.test.tsx` — 22 passed
- `npx tsc --noEmit` — clean

Observation for the PM (not touched, out of scope): `move(1)` ("Сдвинуть вниз") calls `reorder(scope, key, other)` with `below=false`, which reinserts the row before its next sibling — a silent no-op for every row, single-host included. Present since 0.4.0; likely wants `below=true` or swapped args in a follow-up.

```plan-fact
[
  {"item":1,"status":"done","evidence":["app.tsx:3463-3466","project-reorder.test.tsx:90-98","cmd:sh /tmp/pf-reorder/check.sh"]},
  {"item":2,"status":"done","evidence":["app.tsx:3463-3466","project-reorder.test.tsx:100-108","cmd:sh /tmp/pf-reorder/check.sh"]},
  {"item":3,"status":"done","evidence":["app.tsx:3463-3466","project-reorder.test.tsx:110-129","cmd:npx vitest run project-reorder.test.tsx"]},
  {"item":4,"status":"done","evidence":["cmd:sh /tmp/pf-reorder/check.sh"]}
]
```

APPROACH: Reproduced the PM's root cause in `siblingKeys("projects")` — the `Map` kept the last root per projectId while rows key on the first — and replaced it with `visibleRoots.map(...)`, which is exactly the rendered row-key set. Added `project-reorder.test.tsx` covering both drop directions and the "Move up" menu item.

LESSON: When a list is deduplicated for rendering (`visibleRoots`), every index/key lookup over the same domain must derive from that same deduplicated source — a parallel `Map` over raw data silently picks a different representative (last vs first) and breaks `indexOf` matching.

dispatchContext.rulesText:
- In verification scripts and tests that create temp dirs, use /tmp explicitly (mktemp -d /tmp/x.XXXXXX, or TMPDIR=/tmp): the writer sandbox denies mkdtemp in the system TMPDIR under /var/folders. Keep PM-written check scripts in /tmp/<name>/ (the guard blocks .mjs under .agents/).

Done. Changed paths:

- `app.tsx` — `siblingKeys("projects")` now derives row keys from `visibleRoots` (first root per `projectId`), the same source the panel renders rows from. Previously a `Map` kept the **last** root per project, so for a project with copies on several hosts the sibling key (`B|h2`) never matched the rendered row key (`B|h1`): `reorder` bailed on `indexOf < 0`, drops did nothing, and `at = -1` disabled both move menu items. One-line fix at app.tsx:3463-3466.
- `project-reorder.test.tsx` — new jsdom test (panel.test.tsx harness) with 4 cases: single-host drop control, drop below a two-host project → `['B','A']`, dragging a two-host project below another → `['A','B']`, and the "Move up" row-menu item on a two-host project → enabled and calls `['B','A']`.

Verification (all run in this session, exit 0):
- `sh /tmp/pf-reorder/check.sh` — 3 passed
- `npx vitest run project-reorder.test.tsx` — 4 passed
- `npx vitest run panel.test.tsx` — 22 passed
- `npx tsc --noEmit` — clean

Observation for the PM (not touched, out of scope): `move(1)` ("Сдвинуть вниз") calls `reorder(scope, key, other)` with `below=false`, which reinserts the row before its next sibling — a silent no-op for every row, single-host included. Present since 0.4.0; likely wants `below=true` or swapped args in a follow-up.

APPROACH: Reproduced the PM's root cause in `siblingKeys("projects")` — the `Map` kept the last root per projectId while rows key on the first — and replaced it with `visibleRoots.map(...)`, which is exactly the rendered row-key set. Added `project-reorder.test.tsx` covering both drop directions and the "Move up" menu item.

LESSON: When a list is deduplicated for rendering (`visibleRoots`), every index/key lookup over the same domain must derive from that same deduplicated source — a parallel `Map` over raw data silently picks a different representative (last vs first) and breaks `indexOf` matching.
